It is the 2nd Annual Carolinas Sketch Crawl, organized jointly by artists from the Urban Sketchers Asheville, Charlotte, and Greenville chapters (recipients of an Urban Sketchers International Regional Events Grant), not a one-off commercial tour. Urban Sketchers is a global community of on-location sketching artists with standing local chapters, and this event is explicitly built around that returning membership rather than a rotating public audience.
